tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen is the batch compensation workspace for the standard, special and review steps. Required prop: batchId (no default). It needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated special-passenger (特殊旅客) booking-list variant exists: the query returned only bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen (omitted.items=0), the paginated traveler booking list with search and filters. Required prop: navigate; initialStatus is optional; queries and actions are permission-gated.

PasswordInput is a password field with show/hide labels; it has no required props. It must be used inside UiFormField: errors are not rendered by PasswordInput itself but passed as a string `error` prop and displayed by the UiFormField field wrapper.

Only bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen was surfaced: the single query '预订列表 搜索栏 筛选面板' returned the list screen (search + filters, required prop navigate) with omitted.items=0, and no separate search-bar or filter-panel catalog entries. The two requested IDs/import paths could therefore not be confirmed within the one-search-per-task budget; no retry was attempted.

AuthRecoveryDialog is the global dialog that subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; it has no required props, should be mounted once near the app root, and renders null while no recovery event is pending. (Its view variant common.AuthRecoveryDialogView requires `detail`.)

notes: All 5 searches used --layer auto; every search report returned layerSource="auto" (layer inferred from the top-ranked result): tasks 1-4 -> layer="feature", task 5 -> layer="shared-ui". One get (auth.PasswordInput, task 3) was used to confirm the error-display constraint; totals: 5 searches + 1 get = 6 catalog calls. Task 4's single permitted query ('预订列表 搜索栏 筛选面板') matched only bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen with omitted.items=0, so the dedicated search-bar/filter-panel IDs could not be confirmed and no second search was run, per the strict one-search-per-task budget. Task 2 likewise returned a single item (no special-passenger variant). No project files, source, or component-catalog.json were read; project files were not modified.
